name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Courage & Bravery
targetBeneficiaries: Senior citizens who have displayed extraordinary courage in the face of grave danger
briefDescription: The Vayoshreshtha Samman: Courage & Bravery award recognizes senior citizens who have shown exceptional courage in dangerous situations. It is conferred annually by the President of India.
descriptionMd: This national award, "Vayoshreshtha Samman: Courage & Bravery," is designed to honor senior citizens who have demonstrated extraordinary courage. It aims to recognize and celebrate their exceptional bravery when facing grave danger, setting inspiring examples for the community.
benefitsMd:
- Recognition for extraordinary courage.
- Award conferred by the Hon’ble President of India.
- Ceremony held at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi.
eligibilityMd:
- Must be a senior citizen.
- Must have displayed extraordinary courage.
- The courageous act must have been in the face of grave danger.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
